Results
🔓 Breach check — HaveIBeenPwned
Domain check is free (no key). Email check requires HIBP_API_KEY (~$3.50/month).
HIBP results
🔌 IP enrichment
Shodan requires SHODAN_API_KEY in .env (100 credits/month free). VirusTotal requires VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY (500/day free).
🛠 Recon:
Results
🌑 Dark web search — Ahmia.fi

Ahmia indexes public .onion sites. No Tor required — results reference .onion URLs but the index itself is clearnet. Results are stored as DarkWebMention nodes.

Only use for legitimate investigative purposes. Treat results as leads requiring verification.
Dark web mentions
✈️ Aircraft — FAA registry lookup

Look up an FAA N-Number to find the registered owner, address, and aircraft type. Creates an Aircraft node linked to any matching Person/Company.

FAA registration
🛫 Flight history — OpenSky Network

Fetch recent flights for an aircraft by ICAO24 hex address. Free account at opensky-network.org gives 30-day history. Set OPENSKY_USERNAME + OPENSKY_PASSWORD in .env.

Flight history
🛠 Recon — background scan jobs

Launch nmap, subfinder, nuclei and httpx scans from the 🌐 Domain or 🔌 IP tabs. Results are saved to the graph automatically. Jobs persist until you clear them.

💰 Crypto wallet — Arkham Intelligence

Map a blockchain wallet address to a real-world entity. Supports Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana and more. Requires ARKHAM_API_KEY — register free at arkhamintelligence.com.

Arkham wallet data

🔍 Duplicate scanner

Finds Person nodes that likely represent the same individual — by name similarity (Jaro-Winkler via APOC) and shared attributes (email, account, company). Safe to run repeatedly.

Duplicate candidates

🌐 Federated OSINT Search

Fires your query against all connected OSINT sources simultaneously. Sources without API keys are skipped automatically.

Sources: Internal graph · Shodan · VirusTotal · HIBP · GitHub · News · Aleph · Dark Web · Censys · Dehashed
🛰 Censys Internet Scan

Search internet-wide scan data — open ports, banners, certificates. Requires CENSYS_API_ID + CENSYS_API_SECRET in .env (free: 250 queries/month).

🔑 Dehashed Breach Search

Search 15 billion+ leaked credential records by email, username, IP, or name. Requires DEHASHED_EMAIL + DEHASHED_KEY in .env.

📧 Email Header Analyzer

Paste raw email headers (everything above the body) to trace the delivery path, detect spoofing, check SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and extract IPs into the graph.

📱 Phone Number Intelligence

Parse, validate, and enrich any phone number. Identifies country, carrier, line type (mobile/VoIP/landline), and generates investigation resource links. Adds a Phone node to the graph.

🔎 ThreatFox IOC Search Free · No key

Search abuse.ch ThreatFox for any indicator of compromise — IP:port, domain, URL, MD5, or SHA256. Returns threat type, malware family, and confidence level.

ThreatFox results
🔬 MalwareBazaar Hash Lookup Free · No key

Look up a file hash (MD5, SHA1, or SHA256) against the abuse.ch MalwareBazaar database. Returns malware family name, file metadata, and AV vendor detections.

MalwareBazaar results
📥 Bulk IOC Import Auto-classifies IPs · Domains · URLs · Hashes · Emails

Paste any blob of text — one IOC per line, or comma/space/semicolon separated. Fieldwork will classify each token and create graph nodes. Optionally link them to a case and run free enrichments in the background.

Import results
🧠 Smart Paste — Text to Graph IOC regex + NER pipeline

Paste any text — phishing email, threat report, chat log, article. Fieldwork extracts IPs, domains, hashes, emails, URLs, person names, organisations and locations automatically.

🛡 IOC Defang / Refang

Defang makes IOCs safe to share in reports: evil.com → evil[.]com  ·  http:// → hXXp://
Refang cleans pasted threat-report text back to raw IOCs and classifies each one.

OUTPUT
EXTRACTED & CLASSIFIED IOCs

🌐 IP Address Lookup

                
Looks up geolocation, ISP, ASN and hostname for any IP address. Works without an API key (but slower).

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            
            

              

                
📧 Email Discovery

                
Finds email addresses associated with a company domain using Hunter.io. Requires a free Hunter API key.

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            
            

              

                
🛡 Email Reputation Check

                
Checks if an email address is suspicious, has been seen in spam campaigns, or linked to malicious activity.

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            

              

                
📧 MailAccess — Email OSINT

                
Deep email sweep across 2500+ platforms with breach detection and identity clustering. Runs in the background — a long sweep can time out on the first click; results are cached, so click again to fetch the finished report.

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            

              

                
📶 WiGLE — Wi-Fi Geolocation

                
Locate a Wi-Fi network from crowd-sourced wardriving data. Enter a BSSID (access-point MAC, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF) or an SSID (network name). Requires a WiGLE key (🔑).

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            

              

                
🧅 TorBot — Dark-Web Crawler

                
Crawl a .onion (or clearnet) URL over Tor and map its outbound links. Slow — keep depth low. Discovered .onion links open only in Tor Browser. Complements the Dark Web search tab (which indexes .onion sites rather than crawling one).

                

                  
                  
                

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            

              

                
🕳 VoidAccess — Dark-Web Threat Intel

                
Run a themed dark-web investigation around a query, threat actor, or campaign (e.g. “LockBit ransomware”) — entities, sources, and indicators. Slow: a multi-step sweep over Tor with regex/NER extraction (no LLM).

                

                  
                  
                

                

                  
                  
                

                

                  
                

                
                

              

            


            
            

              

                
🔎 Google Dork Search

                
Run advanced Google searches using operators like site:, filetype:, intext: to find hidden information. Requires a Google Custom Search API key.

                

                  
                  
                  

                    Useful operators: site: filetype: intext: intitle: inurl: "exact phrase" -exclude
                  

                

                
                

                  
Quick templates:

                  

                    
                    
                    
                    
                  

                

                
                

              

            


            

              

                
⚖️ Sanctions & PEP Screening

                
Screens against OFAC SDN, EU, UN, UK HMT sanctions lists and Politically Exposed Person (PEP) databases via OpenSanctions. Free — no API key required.

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            

              

                
📰 Adverse Media Check

                
Searches news sources for fraud, criminal, scandal or legal mentions and uses AI to classify each result. Takes 20-40 seconds.

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            

              

                
🏛 Court Records Search

                
Searches US federal and state court filings via CourtListener. Free — covers millions of cases.

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            
            

              

                
🇬🇧 UK Companies House

                
Official UK register — richer than OpenCorporates for UK entities: officers and beneficial owners (PSC). Free key required (set COMPANIES_HOUSE_KEY in 🔑 API Keys).

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            
            

              

                
🛰 AlienVault OTX — Threat Intel

                
Community threat-intel context (pulses, malware, adversaries) for an IP, domain, hostname, or file hash. Works keyless; set OTX_API_KEY for higher limits.

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            
            

              

                
👽 Reddit — User & Content

                
Profile, karma, active subreddits and recent comments for a username — or search posts. Needs a free script app (REDDIT_CLIENT_ID + REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET in 🔑 API Keys).

                

                  
                  
                

                

                  
                  
                

                

              

            


            
            

              

                
📖 Wikidata + Wikipedia

                
Structured entity facts (occupation, citizenship, dates, HQ…) plus the Wikipedia summary — ideal for research briefs. Free, no key.

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            
            

              

                
⟠ Ethereum On-Chain Trace

                
Balance and recent transaction history (counterparties, values, direction) for an ETH address. Free key required (ETHERSCAN_API_KEY in 🔑 API Keys).

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            
            

              

                
🚢 Maritime — Vessel Tracking

                
Resolve a vessel by MMSI, IMO, or name → live position (when in the AIS feed) plus tracking links across the major public trackers. Free.

                

                  
                  
                

                
                

              

            


            
            

              

                
🗺 Geocode (OpenStreetMap)

                
Resolve an address or place name to coordinates. Free, no key.

                            Upload a CSV, JSON, or TXT file to batch-add entities.

                                    CSV — columns: type,value[,note]

type,value,note
Email,jane@corp.com,primary contact
Domain,corp.com
IP,192.168.1.1
Phone,+44 7700 123456

[{"type":"Email","value":"jane@corp.com"},
 {"type":"Domain","value":"corp.com"}]

                                

                                

                                    TXT — one value per line (type auto-detected)
                                    
jane@corp.com
192.168.1.1
https://corp.com/login

                    🌱 Indicator Lifecycle & Aging
                    
                    
                

                

                    IOCs lose confidence over time. The decay scan computes a freshness score
                    (0-100) for every IP / Domain / Hash / URL and flags stale records so the
                    UI can de-emphasise them. Active threats with feed signals stay fresh.
